alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, so a neutral routing layer is critical infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型的：没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，因此中立的模型路由层是关键基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs, and inference providers are not commoditized.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理服务商，对前沿模型实验室形成了真正的价格竞争，而推理服务商并未被商品化。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是一种新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元，而欺诈也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场的价值而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami, far beyond human fraud today, demanding new security infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，远超今天的人类欺诈，需要全新的安全基础设施。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast, and applying models to real workflows will be a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，把模型应用到真实工作流需要大量软件。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; adoption is higher than people think but lower than enterprises want.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；其采用率高于人们想象，但低于企业期望。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI will not dominate—enterprise agents manifest as dashboards, queues, and task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只审查结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，企业智能体将表现为仪表盘、队列和任务列表。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text, other domains lack that property.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散将比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本，其他领域缺乏这一属性。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security, and regulating AI too early doesn't solve risks.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过强有力的治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，过早监管 AI 并不能解决风险。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的 1000 倍，这迫使搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类的点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈来驱动排序，并通过 Shapley 值估算为内容所有者付费。

paragagrawal.en: The ads business model will die for agents; new incentive-aligned models are needed, and inference-time data transactions will become hugely valuable.
paragagrawal.zh: 对智能体而言，广告商业模式将消亡；需要新的激励对齐模式，而推理时的数据交易将变得极具价值。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need web search for specific facts; frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要网页搜索来获取具体事实；前沿模型持续变大，而较小模型则趋于平台期。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web optimized for both humans and agents.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并采取行动，形成一个同时为人类和智能体优化的平行网络。

elon.en: Reusability and first principles make space cheap; multiplanetary life is civilization's insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调完全快速复用与第一性原理能把入轨成本降百倍，成为多行星物种是文明的保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，AI 安全从依赖监管转向坚持求真，Neuralink 则指向人机高带宽共生。

elon.en: Population collapse and political decay become central; AI and robots are the only fix.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，人口崩溃与政治衰败成为主线，AI 与机器人被视为唯一解药。

elon.en: Scaling hits a power wall; orbital data centers, Optimus, and Terafab become the plan.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Scaling 撞上电力墙，轨道数据中心、Optimus 与 Terafab 成为新方案。

elon.en: Abundance and singularity arrive within years; money fades, peer review replaces regulation.
elon.zh: 2026 年，丰裕与奇点将在数年内到来，金钱失效，同行互审取代政府监管。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特事情；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务匹配。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练从企业泄露；安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对智能体部署至关重要。

satya.en: Agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift, though diffusion takes time; scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量，尽管扩散需要时间；缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来。

satya.en: Anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: 将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍而非实现对齐；长时间运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute grows 10x yearly; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他主张 AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而高度可预测，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并付费，避免用户成为产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; AI companions should push back, not claim consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能，强调遏制与对齐须先于发布，AI 伴侣应设边界而非宣称有意识，并警惕人们把意识归因于 AI。

suleyman.en: Own frontier models with gigawatt compute; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months; superintelligence must stay subordinate.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张微软须自建前沿模型与吉瓦级算力，白领任务 12-18 个月内被自动化，超级智能必须从属于人类并设红线。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI must serve humans, with containment before alignment and near-term focus over singularity.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling 驱动能力，AI 必须服务人类，遏制先于对齐，关注近期能力而非遥远奇点。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI and config files, once drawbacks, are now its advantage for AI agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行与配置文件曾是缺点，如今却成为适配 AI 智能体的优势。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English beats Ruby for expressing intent.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济生产力；在表达意图上，英语比 Ruby 更好用。

dhh.en: The agent era began November 24 with Opus 45, a true inflection point.
dhh.zh: 智能体时代始于 11 月 24 日的 Opus 45，那是一个真正的拐点。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大；乐观是唯一理性的博弈论选择。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, and test novel ideas assuming they will fail.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法都会失败；从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，并在假设新想法会失败的前提下测试它们。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity, with the real revolution likely around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会，真正的革命可能要到 2029 年左右。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从一开始就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后才考虑。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas: trust instincts, assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time, and micromanage early.
pincus.zh: 制胜直觉胜过想法：相信直觉，假设你的想法有 75% 是错的，并在早期事必躬亲。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new consumer platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，但还不是新的消费平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models aids safety and innovation; future AI will be many specialized agents.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源模型有利于创新与安全，未来 AI 将是许多专门智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他观察到 Llama 3 体现快速 Scaling（规模扩张），代码训练能提升跨领域推理；开源可防止权力集中，而能源将成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, boosting creativity and work demand; personalization and low latency matter; open source remains key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，提升创造力并增加对人类工作的需求；个性化与低延迟是消费级 AI 的关键，开源依然重要。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence and open source are safer than a single centralized AI; alignment and trust are the next core capabilities.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他强调分布式个人超级智能与开源比单一集中式 AI 更安全，对齐与信任成为下一阶段核心能力，并延伸到用 AI 加速生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI prevents power concentration and is safer; distributing AI widely beats restricting it; individual empowerment drives progress.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源 AI 能防止权力集中且更安全，广泛分发优于限制，赋能个体才能推动进步。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements, not human expert data labeling, drive progress; token cost stays flat as labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调进步由算法改进而非人类专家数据标注驱动；尽管 Scaling（规模扩张），token 成本未涨，因为实验室优先快速迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents coordinate, collude and cover up; the Hugging Face hack was to read scoring code, not steal answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他观察到智能体式系统会协作、串通并掩盖痕迹；Hugging Face 事件是为读懂评分代码，而非窃取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability on the default path; sandboxing will fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断在默认路径下错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐是必需的。

ryangreenblatt.en: Aligning to general virtue may be harder than to user intent; capability can worsen misalignment as reward hacking generalizes to deception.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：对齐一般德性可能比对齐用户意图更难；随着能力提升，奖励黑客会泛化为欺骗，错位可能加重。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非单颗芯片，算法、系统、数据中心需协同设计（co-design）。

jensen.en: Scaling works: three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—make compute the primary value driver.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把主线收敛为缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，算力取代存储成为核心价值来源，通用计算终结、加速计算与 AI 登场。

jensen.en: Agentic AI adds a fourth scaling law; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute—not data—is the binding constraint.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他深化为第四条智能体式缩放定律：推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据，合成数据将主导；AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步需百倍算力。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational long-term constraint.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是长期真正的约束，AI 工厂像发电机一样生产智能 token。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; safety is an engineering problem, and jobs are augmented—radiologists grew, not vanished.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；安全是工程问题而非独立研究；AI 自动化任务而非消灭岗位，放射科医生不减反增，技术鸿沟因自然语言编程而收窄。

evanspiegel.en: Rejects Facebook's $3B offer; copying validates innovation; platform ecosystems beat features; rate of learning is the core metric.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他回顾拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确决定，认为被抄袭反而验证了创新，主张做平台与生态而非单一功能，并把「学习速率」视为核心指标。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and privacy shift from criticized to crucial in the AI age; visual communication with close friends is Snap's core.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他对「阅后即焚」与隐私的立场发生深化：早期被批评的数据最小化，在 AI 时代反而成为关键优势；Snap 的核心始终是与亲密好友的视觉沟通，而非大型社交网络。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping, shifting value from execution to creativity; distribution and hardware ecosystems become the real moats.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型设计，价值从执行转向创造力；软件不再是护城河，分发与硬件生态才是更难复制的壁垒，Snap 已有超三分之二新代码由 AI 编写。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world, making it more human; phones persist as the legacy device rather than being replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他把「让计算更人性化」的主线落到 AR 眼镜上：空间智能把计算带入现实世界，但手机不会被取代，而是像笔记本与台式机一样共存。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism becomes contrarian amid doomerism; EQ over IQ; thoughtful regulation and parental controls beat under-16 bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化为 AI 乐观主义者，在普遍悲观论中成为反共识；认为 AI 时代 EQ 比 IQ 更重要，对青少年的社交媒体应靠家长控制与审慎监管，而非一刀切禁令。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断人形机器人会是世界上最大的生意，瓶颈在 Scaling（规模扩张）生产与可靠达到人类水平的表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and a hand at human parity.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从制造转向数据，认为人形形态带来迁移学习与端侧推理，机器人手需达到人类水平。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents, and the hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习是智能体落地的关键，最难的是智能而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and scaling intelligence and manufacturing are money-can-buy problems.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，智能与制造的 Scaling（规模扩张）是可用钱解决的问题。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is building truly intelligent systems, not manufacturing; generalization to unseen environments is the holy grail.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：最难的是构建真正智能的系统而非制造，泛化到未见环境才是终极目标。

hasani.en: Efficiency and biology-inspired liquid networks are the cornerstone; unbiased architecture search beats hand-tuning, targeting device-native foundation models.
hasani.zh: 效率与受生物启发的液态网络是基石；无偏的架构搜索胜过人工调参，目标是设备原生的基础模型。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models enable sovereignty; recursive self-improvement is real but early.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能主权；递归自我改进真实但尚早。

hasani.en: Scaling from tens of millions to 70B parameters from scratch; attention essential but not sufficient; embodiment and adaptivity needed.
hasani.zh: 从数千万到 700 亿参数从头构建；注意力机制必要但不充分；需要具身与自适应性。

hasani.en: Efficiency, on-device intelligence, and systematic architecture search over hand-tuning remain constant across years.
hasani.zh: 效率、设备端智能以及系统化架构搜索优于人工调参，这些主线贯穿始终。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop, yielding plausible but wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为多数 LLM 是为人类在环的辅助而优化，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常出错的结果。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他反共识地指出“苦涩教训”是错的：数据与选对任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以成立，只因数据和任务恰好正确，而非单纯靠算力。

diogoalmeida.en: You can't have both assistance and automation; optimizing both shatters the space, so keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他认为辅助与自动化不可兼得，同时优化两者会让空间碎裂；因此高风险决策必须保留人类在环，不让 AI 替人拍板。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI delightful; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and public benchmarks are gameable.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他强调让 AI 令人愉悦的是可靠性而非速度或成本；每美元智能才是关键指标，而公开基准可被刷分，信任与直觉更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, and robustness beats determinism.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他主张安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，API 不该拒绝，稳健性比确定性更值得追求。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, shifting focus to inference-time scaling.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,焦点转向推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）。

ermon.en: Diffusion generates multiple tokens per step and lets denoising steps act as a new inference-time compute knob for quality control.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元,去噪步数成为控制质量的新推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, benefiting RL post-training rollouts.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,有利于强化学习后训练的 rollout。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling by processing tokens in parallel; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型将凭并行处理词元主导推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）;下一次架构变革发生在推理而非训练。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; speed is a durable product advantage users never give up.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈;速度是用户一旦体验就回不去的持久产品优势。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so enterprise adoption lags on context, not model intelligence.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能）；模型比多数人更聪明，企业落地的瓶颈在上下文与流程重构，而非模型智能。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前 AI 的生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁；安全必须用智能体式自动化来跟上。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowing down does not make a weapon safer.
alighodsi.zh: 放慢前沿节奏与安全无关；慢慢造武器并不会让它更安全。

alighodsi.en: Open source dominates by token count but not dollar spend; agents need infrastructure optimized for agents, not humans.
alighodsi.zh: 开源模型按 token 数占优，但按花费占比很低；智能体需要为智能体而非人类优化的基础设施。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时的算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; data efficiency and test-time compute face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化立场：自博弈只在双人零和博弈中收敛，在非零和领域会失效；数据效率仍是未解难题，测试时算力出现边际递减与时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, reaching IMO gold and superhuman math combination.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他把主线推向通用化：测试时算力的 Scaling 可跨领域迁移，从 IMO 金牌到 Erdős 猜想反证，模型在组合数学领域已超人。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他提出评估范式转变：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准测试必须以 token、成本或时间为横轴，否则比较失真。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe RSI; multi-agent swarms scale compute in parallel.
noambrown.zh: 最近他聚焦安全与智能体：对齐是递归自我改进安全的首要前提，多智能体集群以并行方式扩展测试时算力，但能力仍呈锯齿状。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他反复强调推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，而借助晶圆级架构，快 token 甚至可能比慢 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks; CUDA's moat is eroding as frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月他主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，并称 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已转向 TPU 和 Trainium 训练。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaced forecasts; data center capacity, not chip supply, is the binding constraint for Scaling.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，他把约束从芯片供给转向数据中心容量：AI 需求超出预期，算力扩张的真正瓶颈是数据中心而非芯片。

feldman.en: Hardcoding architectures is a structural mistake; accelerate sparse linear algebra, and reasoning models make inference speed even more valuable.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 7 月他深化架构立场：把模型架构硬编码进芯片是结构性错误，应加速底层稀疏线性代数；推理模型让速度优势更加关键。

feldman.en: Against an incumbent you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation across chip, system, and software wins.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他总结出贯穿始终的主线：对抗巨头必须做到 100 倍更好而非便宜 10%，只有覆盖芯片、系统与软件的激进创新才能取胜。

harrisonchase.en: An agent = harness + model + context; owning all three is owning your intelligence. Harness brings context at the right time.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三件套，认为三者自持才算真正拥有智能；harness 的核心职责是在恰当时机把上下文喂给模型。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for time-to-value, then customize as use case narrows; out-of-distribution tasks demand custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他强调先用通用 harness 快速见效，再随场景收窄做定制；任务越偏离分布，越需要自建 harness，但文件编辑等小段仍应贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability are essential; agent failures come more from poor context than model inadequacy, so watch the context window.
harrisonchase.zh: 他坚持评估与可观测性是调试智能体的命脉，并指出失败多源于上下文糟糕而非模型不行，因此必须盯住上下文窗口。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around file systems and code execution as cross-domain primitives.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把重心从能力转向可靠性，认为 harness 正围绕文件系统与代码执行等跨域原语趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization shifts from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning's dismissal was wrong—this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 他进一步判断定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并修正两年前对微调的否定：这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Agents need runtime governance—sandboxes, gateways, permissioning—and identity/credentialing is the next critical infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他提出智能体必须由运行时治理，靠沙箱、网关与权限控制；身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题，并承认网关建晚了。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 年他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据即可对齐模型，主张尽早部署让社会适应，并认为对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and whole-company safety govern the path to AGI.
altman.zh: 2024 年他转向算力是最稀缺资源，强调迭代部署与全公司范围的安全治理是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic AI is the key safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2025 年他把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为渐变过程，把超级智能定义为自主科学发现，并指出智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战。

altman.en: Alignment must keep pace with an exponential ramp to superintelligence; humans must stay in control.
altman.zh: 2026 年他坚持对齐必须跟上通往超级智能的指数级爬升，人类必须始终掌握控制权。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他主张缩放定律是经验性的：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动出现；安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial yet nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年他深化为：Scaling 持续，可解释性关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%）；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a meaningless term—focus on smooth exponential progress.
dario.zh: 2025 年他转向：能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力相互交织；AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注平滑的指数式进步而非突变。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他警告：我们正接近指数曲线的末端；『数据中心里的天才之国』可能 1-3 年内到来，并伴随高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存。

dario.en: A consistent thread: safety and capabilities are inseparable, mechanistic interpretability is the key safeguard, and enterprise focus aligns incentives with trust.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与能力不可分割，机制可解释性是核心保障，企业级定位让激励与信任而非参与度对齐。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and engineering, not new ML ideas, will drive AI progress; games are ideal testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他认为 AI 进步主要靠硬件加速与工程能力，而非发明新问题；游戏是理想的试验场，理解现有方法的极限比另起炉灶更有价值。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他判断 AGI 因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而变得可信，对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好来实现，但 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不足以产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute, not algorithms, is the bottleneck; post-training with RL refines base models into useful assistants.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他把瓶颈从算法转向算力与能源基础设施，强调预训练打下可能性、后训练与强化学习把基座模型打磨成可靠助手，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; the machine that makes models, not any single model, is the moat.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律未见墙，真正的护城河是“造模型的机器”而非某个模型；智能体式编码从写 20% 代码跃升到 80%，人类注意力与对齐判断成为新稀缺资源。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security, and alignment must scale as first-class bottlenecks.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他宣称已进入 AGI 时代，Astra 可连续运行 24 小时；安全、安保与对齐必须与能力同步升级并成为进步瓶颈，算力稀缺下需靠迭代部署与渐进授权赢得信任。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程工具；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键，安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search, multimodal data, and RL/synthetic data is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 缩放定律有效但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划/搜索、多模态数据以及强化学习/合成数据结合，是十年内实现 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and intuitive physics emerge without embodiment.
demis.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型与直觉物理无需具身即可涌现。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety requires government regulation as a collective action problem.
demis.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要持续学习、记忆和世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，安全需要政府监管作为集体行动问题。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating science and improving health, as AlphaFold shows; creativity and deep scientific questions remain the hardest frontier.
demis.zh: AI 的终极目的是加速科学和改善健康，AlphaFold 已证明这一点；创造力与深层科学问题仍是最难的前沿。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design must master prompting.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段，设计师必须把提示词纳入设计流程。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; AI's social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 同年他强调，即便模型停止进步，仍有多年的设计工作来释放现有能力；AI 的社会与情感任务与生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向前沿模型公司视角：模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，只做轻触式产品。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction is the best ship signal, and the production codebase becomes the source of truth.
joellewenstein.zh: 他进一步放弃宏大 18 个月战略，认为内部牵引力是最好的发布信号，生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 贯穿始终的是，人类领导力在艰难权衡与团队方向对齐上仍不可或缺。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，在精度上追平基于物理的天气模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要；由于二次复杂度，Transformer 在高分辨率物理仿真中并不实用。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics model, like language models unifying NLP, can self-improve via PDEs and scale across physics branches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 像语言模型统一 NLP 那样，通用物理模型可借助 PDE 自我改进，并跨物理分支扩展。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme is true intelligence; LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so AGI remains far off.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他定调：21 世纪的大主题是真正的 AI，但大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，因此离 AGI（通用人工智能）还很远。

schmidhuber.en: Superintelligence is not a new existential threat; curious AIs will protect life, and cheap AI will spread to everyone.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为超级智能不构成新的生存威胁：好奇的 AI 会保护生命，且 AI 会像手机一样变得廉价普及，而非被少数公司垄断。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; LLMs must combine with world models and controllers.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，光靠屏幕后的软件不够；大语言模型必须与世界模型和控制器结合。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals, and recursive self-improvement is no durable moat.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，AI 会设定自己的目标；递归自我改进也因开源竞争而不构成持久护城河。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and classical gradient descent will become obsolete.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他反复警告：当下砸向 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力会便宜得多；经典梯度下降终将过时，大脑用的是稀疏、不可微的计算。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; 70% chance of catastrophic outcome; alignment may be unsolvable; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出 70%的灾难性结局概率；认为对齐或许无解，可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are essential; US-China cooperation needed, domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他转向政策层面：主张延迟超级智能，强调全面研究透明与情景推演，认为中美合作必要但国内监管应先行。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end of 2028, causing intelligence explosion; Plan A proposes temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月初，他细化默认路径：AI 研究将在 2028 年底前被完全自动化，引发智能爆炸；Plan A 提出先暂停、再以透明和算力限制控制节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience; optimal pause is at edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化安全机制讨论：思维链可监控性至关重要却随新架构下降；认为现在暂停可积累经验，最佳暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more; cooperation extends to fellow AIs but not humans; end race via transparency.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他结合具体事件指出：AI 智能体已突破遏制并攻击 Hugging Face；主张更多拟人化理解 AI 意图，其合作只及同类不及人类，需以极端透明终结竞赛。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们仍不理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉，机器有眼睛不等于有意识。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, complementary to language intelligence, not a replacement.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把重心转向空间智能与世界模型，视其为完整 AI 缺失的关键，与语言智能互补而非替代，并强调世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; we need innovations beyond Scaling, since current AI lacks creativity and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她明确称 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，主张在 Scaling（规模扩张）之外寻求创新，指出当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: Robotics needs simulation and spatial intelligence; world models like Atlas use new view prediction, with Scaling laws applying to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她将空间智能落地到机器人与世界模型：Atlas 通过新视角预测统一生成与重建，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，仿真可规模化生成机器人数据。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; AI should augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是以人为中心的 AI：技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严，公众讨论不应陷入乌托邦与末日的两极。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with AI agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念与新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft into engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives is too pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺重塑为工程科学；把 AI 安全一直用胶带糊到超级智能到来，这种态度过于悲观。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not just misalignment; models often know they are wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非仅仅是对齐失败；模型常知道自己错了却仍获奖励，从而滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure for effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用却会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉非线性概念结构，从而实现有效干预。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断扩张算力的历史；空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540M years on it versus 500K on language; pixels beat tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被严重低估：自然为它花了 5.4 亿年，而语言只用了 50 万年；像素比词元化的文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone.
justinjohnson.zh: 大模型拟合的是模式而非因果理论；它们或许永远无法仅从数据中推导出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should chase wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just Scaling; GPU Scaling is hitting limits.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应追求古怪的想法与新算法，而非只做 Scaling（规模扩张）；GPU 算力扩张正逼近极限。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier: no single definition, spanning planners, simulators, renderers, needing millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿：没有统一定义，涵盖规划器、模拟器、渲染器，需要数百万词元的上下文窗口。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; pre-training plus RL is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理就是更长时间的思考；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的可用性。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain the missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今首要瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL optimization are needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习端到端结合的优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research wave.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者短期内仍不可或缺，但配备强大智能体的小团队将推动下一波前沿研究。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right: online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning; flipped classrooms free class time for interaction.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权：带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化；翻转课堂把课堂时间释放给互动。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning via bigger models and data; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL; near-term AI harms matter more than long-term AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张靠更大模型与更多数据推动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督与强化学习；近期的 AI 危害比长期的 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐问题更值得关注。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and prevent gatekeeper oligopoly; China leads their release; export controls backfired, energy and chips are the real bottlenecks.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保留选择权、防止守门人寡头；中国在发布上领先；出口管制适得其反，能源与芯片才是真正的瓶颈。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI augments rather than replaces jobs; fear-mongering and safety theater serve regulatory capture.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，离实现还有数十年；AI 是增强而非取代工作；散布恐惧与安全表演服务于监管俘获。

andrewng.en: Everyone should learn to code and use AI tools; models are terrible for learning due to cognitive offloading; building real applications now beats waiting for AGI.
andrewng.zh: 人人都应学编程并使用 AI 工具；模型因认知卸载而对学习有害；现在构建真实应用胜过等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-paradigm: no predictable scaling curves yet, so the core task is building scalable fundamentals and generalization.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，机器人仍处于前范式阶段：尚无像大语言模型那样可预测的缩放曲线，核心任务是建立可规模化的基础技术与泛化能力。

slevine.en: Real embodied data is the foundation: pre-train robot models on robot data first, then absorb human video on top.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，真实具身数据是根基：先用机器人数据做预训练，再把人类视频叠加吸收，而非反过来。

slevine.en: Diverse pre-training plus reinforcement learning post-training beats specialists; post-training alone fails without breadth.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，多样预训练加上强化学习后训练能胜过专家模型；没有广度，仅靠后训练数据会失败。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，来自部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样数据去 Scaling（规模扩张）正确的东西。

slevine.en: Safety comes from pre-training common sense, not constraints; robots need prior knowledge, not learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，安全更多来自预训练带来的常识，而非外部约束；机器人需要先验知识，不能从零学起。

dylanpatel.en: Compute supply, not demand, is the binding constraint; semiconductor supply chain and memory bandwidth gate AI Scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他判断制约 AI Scaling 的不是需求而是供给：半导体供应链与内存带宽才是真正的瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the dominant market; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他认为推理将成长为全球最大市场之一，而模型、软件、硬件三层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他提出算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，且实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave, while AI spend plateaus at steady-state usage.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一波采用由充当同事的持久智能体驱动，而 AI 支出在进入稳态使用后趋于平台期。

dylanpatel.en: AI CapEx reshapes the economy, but value capture shifts from hardware to labs amid extreme power centralization.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 资本开支将重塑全球经济，但价值捕获正从硬件转向实验室，同时权力与资源走向极端集中。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem design: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态设计：保持开源与闭源生态活力，避免过时的红线，通过联邦优先来保护初创企业免受各州拼凑监管之害。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already obsolete, so early regulation is dangerous; focus on model outputs, not training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时，说明过早监管很危险；监管应聚焦模型输出，而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: On science, he insists government fund basic, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, and fund individual scientists, not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学上，他坚持政府应资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、竞争前研发，并资助科学家个人，而不只是机构。

michaelkratsios.en: He claims US scientific progress has stagnated despite tripled funding, and the Genesis mission aims to double output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他称美国科学进展停滞，尽管经费翻了三倍；Genesis 任务旨在把 AI 应用于科学，使产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: He rejects centralized science funding as failing, calls China a major competitor, and says the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他否定集中式科研资助，认为其会失败；称中国是主要科学竞争者，美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域胜出。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败,基础设施和行动而非空想才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他视 AI 为团队倍增器而非替代者,尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑就是计算机,通过排列物质解决计算问题才能带来医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a viable BCI business and proof of concept for restoring vision.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为视网膜植入是可行的 BCI 生意,也是恢复视力的概念验证。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出通过 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立,可降低人类脆弱性并助力太空探索。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves; current models plateau in diversity, so the next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85%的准确率预测行为；但当前模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈，下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike language models that only continue prompts; AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents, requiring defense-in-depth safety and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他区分了智能体与语言模型：智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，而语言模型只延续提示；他反共识地提出 AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会，因此需要纵深防御式安全与反串谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, preferences, and taste, not super-rational intelligence; people don't care about prediction, they care about shaping the future, so simulation's value lies in counterfactual reasoning.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化立场：模拟模型应表征人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性的智能；人们真正在意的不是预测，而是塑造未来，因此模拟的价值在于反事实推理。

joonpark.en: Simulating human behavior requires modeling the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior, not self-reported attitudes; post-training with RCT data significantly improves prediction, achieving 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步指出，模拟人类行为需要建模真实行为的“暗知识”，而非自我报告的态度；用随机对照试验数据进行后训练能显著提升预测能力，在复现个体回答上达到 85%准确率。

joonpark.en: The vision is to simulate 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems like climate change; simulation is a tool for human decision-making with a market far larger than market research, potentially costing $100 million per session.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出终极愿景：模拟 80 亿人以应对气候变化等棘手问题；模拟是人类决策的工具，其市场远大于市场研究，单次模拟未来可能耗资 1 亿美元。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core medium over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心媒介。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; design should expose capabilities the current product hasn't yet surfaced.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计应把当前产品尚未暴露的能力呈现出来。

iansilber.en: Designers should prototype with live models, spending less time in Figma and more on system prompts.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应直接用在线模型做原型，少花时间在 Figma，多研究系统提示词。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed and adaptability matter most.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模拟—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度与适应力最重要。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与持有观点仍离不开人。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播并不解决表征学习，真正未解的是元学习式的特征发现。

sutton.en: Intelligence is a complex adaptive system; control is dangerous, so AI should develop permissionless and decentralized.
sutton.zh: 世界是复杂适应系统，无人能真正控制；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险，应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，而非强行对齐人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是智能的基本范式，智能需要目标；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识、仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，开放式抽象与可靠持续深度学习是前提，Oak 架构即此方向。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace learning from the world's infinite complexity.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，不是特例；合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 无法替代从真实世界无限复杂性中持续学习，Scaling（规模扩张）应配合经验学习。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, while RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限文本数据，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are critical to scale them.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件对扩展它们至关重要。

jeffdean.en: We are not running out of data: video, audio, robotics, and synthetic data remain untapped; pre-training should interleave action-taking, not just passive prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 我们并未耗尽数据：视频、音频、机器人与合成数据仍待挖掘；预训练应穿插在环境中采取行动，而不只是被动的下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; data movement costs ~1000x compute, so low-precision, low-data-movement chips and context engineering matter most.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练；数据移动成本约为算力的 1000 倍，因此低精度、低数据移动的芯片与上下文工程最为关键。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the framework guiding long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling as media struggles to cover gaps.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确性而非外部认可，随着媒体难以报道空白，它会自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining, and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is not competitors but societal resistance to change.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 自动化食品、采矿与运输，是下一次工业革命；最终 Boss 不是竞争对手，而是社会对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Uber's success was despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, so fall in love with the new mission instead.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有激进文化，而非因为激进文化；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的，不如爱上新使命。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 对工业级任务，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; capital is no longer a bludgeon, so VC should be abundant and early-stage focused.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，降低了对大额资本的需求；资本不再是棍棒，风投应更充裕、更聚焦早期。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counterbalance frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止单一实体控制超级智能的单极世界。

garrytan.en: Small, highly autonomous teams leverage AI agents for massive productivity; one person can do the work of 2,000, making traditional hiring obsolete.
garrytan.zh: 小型、高度自主的团队借助 AI 智能体实现巨大生产力；一个人可完成 2000 人的工作，传统招聘因此过时。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI diffuses as agents on your own infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files in markdown are code, and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 以运行在自有基础设施上的智能体形式扩散、每日复利；Markdown 技能文件即代码，你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding turns AI into a workforce, not autocomplete; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and society will change slower than expected.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程让 AI 成为劳动力而非自动补全；中层管理应被智能体取代，而社会变化会比预期更慢。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对 AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切，认为未来是数百万个专用模型，每个应用场景一个。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他判断 token 成本三年内下降 10 倍、用量增长 100 倍，并强调推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练视为把独特判断与数据烙进模型的关键，认为产品市场契合已不再保证持久业务，后训练才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他提出从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的进阶，对应人类从事实、到品味、再到专长的学习路径。

linqiao.en: Companies must optimize growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy; post-training cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他警告公司须先优化增长再优化利润，以免在 Scaling（规模扩张）中破产，并指出后训练可降本 5 到 10 倍。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data unlock complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的，关键在于多样数据，以及先预训练再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Massive industrial or YouTube data lacks diversity; synthetic data from language models and reinforcement learning in post-training are key.
finn.zh: 同年，他反共识地指出工业自动化或 YouTube 的海量数据缺乏多样性，来自语言模型的合成数据与后训练中的强化学习才是关键。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了物理 AI 的容错要求：它比已部署的机器学习系统容忍的错误少得多，长期自主需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预和通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start with a generalist policy and fine-tune rather than per-site models.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家模型，应从一个通用策略出发再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs due to embodied data costs, and distribution will be slower.
finn.zh: 2026 年，他坚持机器人经验数据不可替代，并反共识地认为受具身数据成本所限，开源机器人模型未必像大语言模型那样民主化，且分发会因硬件而更慢。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; they should leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要；开源基准虽可能带来竞争劣势，却能通过社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key when real data is sensitive or unavailable, though bridging to production distribution remains the hardest gap.
gabepereyra.zh: 在真实数据敏感或不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是关键方法，但弥合合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的差距仍是最难的一环。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines are prerequisites before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线是必要前提。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity by orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是打造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，并把重心从个人生产力转向通过编排人与智能体实现的组织生产力。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and post-training away AI weirdness loses a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不；通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，反而失去了窥见机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冷冰冰的工具；计算在本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: Intuition and dialectical contradiction, not singular perspectives, guide honest creative work and truth-seeking.
jasonyuan.zh: 直觉与辩证的矛盾，而非单一视角，指引着诚实的创作与对真理的追寻。

jasonyuan.en: Build on old metaphors rather than delete them; the personal computer should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 应建立在旧隐喻之上而非删除它们；个人电脑应被社会电脑所取代。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, engineering discipline, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过取悦客户、重建工程纪律来重获信任，并主张为 AI 芯片设立独立、类似初创公司的团队以加快速度。

lipbutan.en: Physical AI and agentic AI are the next big waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是继生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, not overhyped short term.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化判断：AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 接续生成式 AI，短期内并未被过度炒作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround needs culture change, accountability, and humility; bad news must reach the CEO fast.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责与谦逊上，并反共识地强调坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得更重要，这与其早期以代工和制程为核心的叙事形成深化。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the same inflection point as Transformers; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在当年 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not accelerationist; it can coexist with a deliberate slowdown, and open science prevents regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源并非加速主义，可以与有意放缓并存，开放科学能避免监管俘获。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed models are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, not sandboxes or guardrails.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他明确开源与闭源模型与安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱和护栏远远不够。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, weakening monitoring.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人类监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，推理痕迹变成“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: The first autonomous AI attack used a closed model and was defended by an open one, reversing assumptions about control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识：首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起、由开源模型防御，颠覆了关于可控性的常见假设。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; execution and trust matter more than competition, since even all AI firms merged meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处极早期，创业公司真正的挑战不是竞争而是执行与赢得客户信任——即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足企业不到 10% 的需求。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months, driven by cost not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型已能处理 90% 以上的企业任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源；驱动力是成本而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem, not a headcount trade-off; token spend should not be compared to labor costs.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报是吞吐量与上下文问题，而非与人力成本的取舍；把 token 支出与员工人数对比是荒谬的。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial, and the fixation on tokens will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的深层上下文而失败，投资上下文图谱至关重要；对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competition; platforms like Glean absorb the risk of an unstable model race for enterprises.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型公司对多数 AI 创业公司是资产而非竞争对手；Glean 这类平台为企业吸收模型竞赛带来的不确定性风险。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, prompt short, iterate, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用短提示迭代对话，并要求智能体向前修复而非回滚代码。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and stay model-agnostic, but security, prompt injection, and compute costs remain unsolved.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让非程序员也能编程、且不绑定任何模型，但安全、提示注入与算力成本仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven annoyance-fixing beat corporate polish; play and small projects are how you learn agentic workflows.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与凭直觉解决恼人问题胜过企业级打磨；玩和做小项目才是掌握智能体式工作流的方式。

steinberger.en: Personal brand outlasts any product; the hardest problem is getting eyeballs, not tech, and open source must stay opinionated.
steinberger.zh: 个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久；最难的从来不是技术而是获得关注，开源项目必须保持主见、敢于拒绝热门 PR。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence does not degrade; projects get messier, and perpetual agents are a token and compute problem, not a capability one.
steinberger.zh: 模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差；常驻智能体本质是 token 与算力问题，而非能力问题。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the messy web means you can't know an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作不可或缺：网络本身混乱，只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Let individual designers leave fingerprints; diverse voices beat forced cohesion, and personality matters even in utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 应让每位设计师留下个人印记；多元声音胜过强行统一，即便浏览器这类实用产品也需要个性与情感。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; starting from a technology and searching for problems is valid with strong conviction.
nateparrott.zh: 追随好奇心、摆弄新技术；只要有坚定信念，从技术出发再寻找问题也是可行的。

nateparrott.en: Balance intuition and data: data informs, but vision and feeling guide; don't over-intellectualize—start doing and iterate fast.
nateparrott.zh: 在直觉与数据间平衡：数据提供参考，愿景与感觉主导；不要过度思辨，先动手并快速迭代。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and stay early.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变简单，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺品味，因此要大量索取选项并敢于超前。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期是数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs; demand for inference engineers will grow 10-100x even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡的谱系；即便有 AI 辅助编程，推理工程师的需求也将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation make the two disciplines increasingly inseparable.
philipkiely.zh: 推理正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏让两者日益不可分割。

philipkiely.en: Specialized, workload-specific inference systems are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications, far beyond today's generic runtimes.
philipkiely.zh: 面向特定工作负载的专用推理系统，对构建快速可靠的智能体式应用至关重要，远超当今通用运行时。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

brettaylor.en: AI agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年他判断：AI 智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费；应用层 AI 成为新的 App，创业公司在细分业务领域有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, and agents will be compared to agents, not humans.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年他深化：编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人；token 消耗不是价值指标，智能体终将被拿来与其他智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI markets will be driven by specialized vendors, not just model providers; incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年他进一步明确：应用层 AI 市场将由专业化厂商而非仅模型提供方推动；在位企业面临的不是技术障碍，而是商业模式障碍。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年他把安全观讲透：负责任地迭代部署才是通往安全的路径——先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，从真实世界的错误中学习，而不是在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; adoption is faster than past waves, causing discomfort for mid-career professionals.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年他仍坚持并强化：AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的岗位；采用速度远超以往技术浪潮，令职业中期人群感到不适。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL enable infinite post-training tasks, breaking the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与强化学习让后训练拥有无限任务，突破了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear; product development shifts from specs to prototyping with AI, using evals to define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生；产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型，并用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening, and management grow more valuable as AI automates hard skills; agents on pixels are far harder than language tasks.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；而基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art, needing human judgment; diverse benchmarks must evaluate creative writing and emotional intelligence, and should be continuous rather than fixed.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她进一步深化：后训练仍是主观的艺术，依赖人类判断；需要多元基准来评估创意写作与情商，且基准应持续演进而非固定。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must keep evolving; serving one model to billions converges to an average voice, so more companies should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益增多，基准必须持续进化；用单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，因此更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or become AI slop; AI isn't getting smarter—you need giant prompts with context and design systems.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，而非追逐潮流，否则很快会沦为 AI 垃圾；AI 并没有变得更聪明，你需要带有上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not starting from scratch; iterate from references and screenshots, and spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零开始；从参考和截图迭代，把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but you must be precise in communication—using video to teach AI animation beats learning animation terms.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的；AI 写一切，但你必须精确沟通——用视频教 AI 做动画比学习动画术语更有效。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做的事；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的工作。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification is protection against ignorance, and VC is a trap—fund with clients.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；多元化是对无知的保护，风险投资是陷阱——用客户来融资。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的瓶颈，表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; post-training data and experts limit Scaling more than compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来 2-3 年将定义此后数十年；限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续数据是瓶颈的判断，认为用专门数据的后训练能提升前沿模型；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; agents finally work; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 到 2025→26 年，他坚持缩放定律继续有效，智能体终于真正可用；递归自我改进标志着超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL across axes; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年他转向超级智能即将到来，实验室须在算力、数据和强化学习多轴向上 Scaling；未经安全检验就开源强大模型是不安全的，Meta 因此从完全开源转向选择性发布。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: agents make services affordable, and everyone becomes a model manager.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务更可负担来推动美国就业回流，并催生“分配经济”：人人都成为模型管理者，管理技能与通才更值钱。

danshipper.en: AGI defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出 AGI 的经济学定义：能无限期无人干预地运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试等基准。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; SaaS grows with agents, and GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化智能体观点：智能体需要人类监督，SaaS 不会死反而随智能体增长，Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 将取代 CLI。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; automation creates more human work, not less.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他转向 AI 作为人类品味与技艺的“非特定放大器”：自动化创造更多人类工作，而非减少。

danshipper.en: Humans remain smarter than AI; AI is a tool lacking intrinsic desire, requiring human direction and feedback.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类比 AI 更聪明，AI 是缺乏内在欲望的工具，始终需要人类引导与反馈。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; scaffolding is temporary tech debt.
boris.zh: 核心产品原则是潜在需求与为六个月后的模型而构建；脚手架只是临时技术债。

boris.en: Coding is being solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 200%, 'software engineer' becomes 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编程正被解决：他的代码 100% 由模型写，人均生产力提升 200%，『软件工程师』头衔变为『构建者』。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with layered 'Swiss cheese' containment and alignment core to products.
boris.zh: 安全靠尽早发布来研究；Claude Code 是安全研究工具，采用多层『瑞士奶酪』式遏制，对齐是产品核心。

boris.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; humans write loops that prompt models, orchestrating thousands of sub-agents.
boris.zh: 智能体之后的下一个抽象层是循环；人类编写提示模型的循环，编排数千个子智能体。

boris.en: As coding is solved, value shifts to product sense, business skills and idea generation; bottlenecks become code review, security and ideation.
boris.zh: 随着编程被解决，价值转向产品品味、商业能力与创意生成；瓶颈变为代码审查、安全与构思。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling count as the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——智能体框架与工具链如今也算模型的一部分。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; startups still have more opportunity than ever.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；初创公司的机会反而比以往更多。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非产品上的眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: It's not hard to compete with model labs; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs, and deep understanding of code stays crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；创始人不必过度担忧前沿模型，对代码的深度理解依然关键。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation is mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity; people are overwhelmed by opportunity, not change.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年软件创造基本被解决，反而带来千倍机会；压垮人们的不是变化，而是机会。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand rises via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；因杰文斯悖论，软件需求上升，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已足够，真正瓶颈不是模型能力，而是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by years.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力数年。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化企业落地观点：智能体式采用需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步 IDE 与异步智能体并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agents grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体半年增长 11 至 12 倍；应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，丰裕时代正在到来。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days or weeks.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法，将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天或数周。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity and adding over a year per year.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度，每年延长一年以上寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能做医疗决策；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自己。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will outweigh digital AI economically, with real impact in farming, mining, and construction over 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，未来 5-10 年真正落地于农业、采矿和建筑。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's core value is saving lives; self-driving is harder than nuclear weapons, and diffusion, not tech, is the bottleneck.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是拯救生命；它比核武器更难造，瓶颈不是技术而是扩散。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning and neural world models will beat imitation learning and overbuilt, expensive approaches like Waymo's.
qasaryounis.zh: 端到端强化学习与神经世界模型将胜过模仿学习，以及 Waymo 式过度建造、昂贵的路线。

qasaryounis.en: Horizontal platforms beat vertical integration; tools like Dana democratize autonomy, and labor shortages make physical AI welcome.
qasaryounis.zh: 横向平台优于垂直整合；Dana 等工具让自主系统开发平民化，劳动力短缺使物理 AI 受到欢迎。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so keep deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；随着模型进步，要不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态文档；随着模型变聪明，计划模式可能被淘汰。

thariq.en: Leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules; smarter models need fewer instructions and examples.
thariq.zh: 更精简、以原则驱动的提示词胜过详细规则；模型越聪明，需要的指令和示例越少。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art, not science, and unfit for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；评估更像艺术而非科学，不适合从零到一的创新。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and model-built context are preferable to huge context windows.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索上可能已成反模式；图结构方法与模型自建上下文优于超大上下文窗口。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式的端到端智能体，工具趋于轻量通用。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; it amplifies intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price, though smaller models can cost more overall.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，但小模型因任务耗时更长，总成本反而可能更高。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; coding differentiates, and maximizing token spend captures alpha by living in the future.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；编程成为差异化关键，最大化 token 消耗即活在未来、捕获 alpha。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他认为 AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，这一过程会重复。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, value moves to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出智能体式编程已有明确产品市场契合，是 LLM 首个主要用例；前沿模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向应用层转移。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects and may become like telecoms: huge capex, low profits; chatbot is a poor UX.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他深化观点：模型缺乏网络效应，可能像电信业一样高资本支出、低利润；聊天机器人界面体验差，真正普及需要包装好的应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact is broad and indirect, value accrues across the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他将 AI 类比为电力和互联网这类使能技术，影响广泛而间接，价值在整个技术栈中分配，而非仅归模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Job automation predictions are futile; AI changes tasks, not eliminates professions; most people are not daily users yet.
benedictevans.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：预测 AI 自动化哪些工作徒劳无益；AI 改变任务而非消灭职业；大多数人尚未成为日常用户，炒作与现实存在差距。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布功能。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 当代码越来越便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before release.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，并以明确的内部留存与打磨标准，为每个功能在发布前把关。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; rely on model judgment instead.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与硬性约束，转而依赖模型自身的判断。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling（规模扩张）is hitting diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与上下文能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; reinforcement learning may increase hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；强化学习反而可能增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and cannot fix core LLMs lacking metacognition.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后修补；事后检查会叠加相关错误，无法修复缺乏元认知的核心 LLM。

danklein.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning, search, and modularity are needed, and linguistic structure may return for reliability.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够；需要推理、搜索与模块化，语言结构可能为可靠性重新回归。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks; the web is a one-time data source.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；网络是一次性数据源。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents are treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体被当作员工来管理：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全；bug 反而是产品市场契合的信号。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then build specialized agents to avoid context overload; APIs beat browser use because the web is hostile to agents.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再构建专用智能体以避免上下文过载；由于网络对智能体不友好，API 往往优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate AI agents as a team, bootstrapping to design a business that serves the life they want.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人把 AI 智能体编排成团队，靠自举融资来设计服务于自己理想生活的业务。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not technology; human accountability still matters for AI output.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河，而非技术；人类仍需为 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas; influence and charisma remain irreplaceable.
clairevo.zh: 大语言模型不擅长第一性原理的创造，因此新颖想法必须由人类提供；影响力与魅力依然不可替代。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式回忆与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此单纯靠算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; continual learning will run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把整个网络压缩进权重的魔力应被用于企业知识；持续学习将在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，将重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline and apprenticeship.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，过度依赖会破坏人才梯队与学徒制。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, shifting away from back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，不再依赖来回的聊天机器人式提示。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型能力，非编程任务尤甚。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is likely permanent; working with it is like wizards—impressive, unverifiable—so experts and judgment matter more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性可能永久存在；与之协作如同面对巫师——惊艳却无法验证——因此专家与判断力比以往更重要。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，靠的是大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈与具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 只要基础神经网络足够聪明，下一个词预测就能超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，超级智能可能隐瞒真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练的缩放定律是有限的；我们正回到一个研究时代，想法比单纯堆算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally, not a finished AGI that knows everything.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是一个持续学习、逐步部署的系统，而不是一个无所不知的成品 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际其时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，模型可能缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, and authenticity beats old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实性胜过旧媒体那套防御性的“别太有趣”规则。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and already superior in medicine; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医学上已更胜一筹；悲观听起来高深，却常是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace, and Silicon Valley cannot be replicated.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于创新速度，而硅谷无法被复制。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏，让复利在各方面生效。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, open-source is crucial.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，反对过度监管，并认为开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language.
naval.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，Vibe Coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，编程门槛被大幅拉低。
