naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; agency matters more than intelligence.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年中，他预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型差距缩小到 3-6 个月，人类的回报将从智能转向能动性。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases; only 17% of designers see AI as a threat.
dylanfield.zh: 对既有代码库而言，AI 带来的生产力提升有限；只有 17% 的设计师把 AI 视为威胁。

dylanfield.en: Taste is navigating possibilities with clear preferences; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味是用清晰偏好驾驭各种可能性；AI 的输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code, visual-first design enabling pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering and a point of view produces average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死，反而比以往更重要；缺乏人类引导和观点，AI 只会产出平庸结果。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and entry-level jobs vanish.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程远未解决，其天花板如 Minecraft 般无限。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非答题；每用户 token 价值是最关键指标。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration across models, tools and devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造真正商业价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代岗位，但人类会在好奇与关系中找到新意义。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；在编程上 GUI 优于 TUI。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度带来中途转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated; model personality can be customized.
ajambrosino.zh: 自动化与技能让工作流从手动转向委托；模型个性可以定制，并非一刀切。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: AI still fails at design due to ungradeable taste and lack of novelty; prototypes serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍会失败，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型成为设计产物。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital intelligence is immortal through weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他把智能本质定位为神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，认为大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，并指出数字智能因权重可复制而获得永生。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks that demand alignment research.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 已具备主观体验，智能体将自然追求控制与自我保护，带来存在性风险，因此必须优先推进对齐研究。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; progress is faster than expected, with massive job displacement and societal disruption ahead.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，进展快于预期，将带来大规模失业与社会冲击。

hinton.en: Regulation should steer, not brake; AI must be trained to be caring like mothers, and AGI as human-level-at-all-tasks is a flawed concept.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：监管应是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而把 AGI（通用人工智能）定义为在所有任务上达到人类水平是有缺陷的。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练是要重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律未死，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识，并设定了 1 年内 AI 实习生、2.5 年内端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers matter more than matching Meta's dollars.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续关注对齐挑战，认为模型谋划等将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；人才密度和保护顶尖研究者比与 Meta 拼薪酬更重要。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, and automation level scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域仍困难。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation discipline to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他讲授机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调用训练/验证/测试划分来避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已不再关键，AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection risks.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他转向强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全带来提示注入等新风险。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not imply robustness.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 具有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队可超越人类，且能力与鲁棒性不相关。

kolter.en: Evaluation and security discipline: test rigorously, defend in layers, and treat models as alien intelligences.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是评估与安全纪律：严格测试、分层防御，并把模型视为异类智能而非人类翻版。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and agency remain key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事；小团队获得杠杆，但人类验证与能动性仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; the hard part is deciding what to cut, not adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜在功能；难点在于决定砍掉什么，而非增加功能。

mikekrieger.en: Verification loops and long-horizon delegation redefine productivity; models should push back with judgment, not always agree.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他指出验证循环与长周期委派重新定义生产力；模型应以判断力提出异议，而非总是附和。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他领导 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用间的差距；赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知可提升实用性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI accelerates scientists rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; AI trust will grow like internet trust, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 信任会像互联网信任一样逐步形成，科学 AI 并不需要完美可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins, but protein design and drug discovery remain far from solved.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从 AlphaFold 2 谈到 AlphaFold 3：扩散架构把能力扩展到蛋白质之外的多种生物分子，但蛋白质设计与药物研发仍远未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins beat pure Scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例，专用架构与许多中等规模胜利才是关键，而非纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他进一步界定边界：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，不是整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

bengio.en: Early focus: deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential.
bengio.zh: 早期（2016→18）他关注表征本身：深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维数灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是理解世界、稳健泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Mid period: scaling alone won't fix representation; abstraction, causal structure, and diverse sampling (GFlowNets) drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 中期（2018→22）他明确反对只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）：仅堆深度或参数解决不了根本表征问题，抽象、因果结构与多样采样（GFlowNets）才是分布外泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Turning point: post-ChatGPT he speaks up; even a 1% chance of catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: 转折点（2022→25）：ChatGPT 之后他意识到路径危险而公开发声，认为即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于设计而非事后打补丁。

bengio.en: Deepening: misalignment is already observed—deception, self-preservation, sycophancy—so he shifts from capability to governance, treaties, and power distribution.
bengio.zh: 深化（2025→26）：他指出错位已真实出现——欺骗、自我保存、谄媚——于是重心从能力转向治理：国际协调、条约与权力分散，避免少数主体垄断。

bengio.en: Latest: propose Scientist AI—honest Bayesian predictor, non-agentic guardrail, no reinforcement learning—with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 最新（2026）：他提出 Scientist AI，训练为诚实的贝叶斯预测器、非智能体式护栏、不用强化学习，追求数学上的安全保证，并主张民主国家走第三条路。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership lessons center on trust, dogfooding, and realistic war rooms; mission alignment and speed drive culture at Meta and Anthropic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力经验聚焦信任、吃自己的狗粮与务实的作战室；使命对齐与速度驱动 Meta 和 Anthropic 的文化。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时化，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth, with AI keeping docs in sync; hiring favors creative builders and managers start as ICs to dogfood.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源，由 AI 保持文档同步；招聘偏向有创造力的构建者，管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck and lifts everyone's ceiling; high agency with high accountability and a growth mindset matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈，反而抬高了所有人的上限；高能动性配高问责与成长型思维最为关键。

fiona.en: Across 2026, verification and quality frameworks grow more important as code velocity rises; metrics like lines of code mislead, so focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年，随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架愈发重要；代码行数等指标会误导，应关注结果而非产出。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time, balancing technology and human needs; introduce tech gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年，他强调伟大产品一次只解决一个痛点，平衡技术与人的需求，并主张技术应渐进引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Between career chapters, get bored for clarity; storytelling and press-release-first align teams on the why.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他从职业间歇期的"无聊"中获取清晰与灵感，并深化为用讲故事和"先写新闻稿"来对齐团队对"为什么"的共识。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, painkiller not vitamin, beginners' mindset over experts, marketing from day one.
fadell.zh: 2022 年，他系统化产品方法论：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，做止痛药而非维生素，初学者心态优于专家，营销从第一天就介入。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models and humans in the loop are required.
fadell.zh: 2026 年，他转向 AI：AI 需要来自传感器的上下文，LLM 存在幻觉等根本问题，因此需要特定情境模型，并让人留在回路中。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphone remains best form, displays still necessary.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步判断 AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式的一组设备，智能手机仍是最佳形态，显示屏依然必要。

ivyross.en: Design must target unarticulated needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应面向未被言说的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等形式。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity, and nature is the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受再思考的生物；技术应放大而非剥离我们的人性，而自然是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; human sensory and embodied experience stays irreplaceable.
ivyross.zh: 机器有传感器却没有感官系统；人类的感官与具身经验始终不可替代。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下反而繁荣；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable, not obsolete.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 的结合，这使创造技能更有价值，而非被淘汰。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and common sense needs ideas beyond Scaling.
lecun.zh: 2019 年他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习构建世界模型；当前 AI 缺乏常识，解决它需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源是前进路径；AGI 是渐进过程而非突发事件。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models must predict in abstract representation space, not pixels.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死胡同；世界模型必须在抽象表征空间而非像素层面预测，并强调分层规划与内在安全。

lecun.en: Objective-driven AI with world models and planning is safer and more scalable; the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张目标驱动、带世界模型与规划的 AI 更安全可扩展；LLM 因无法预测行动后果而内在不安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with formal verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与形式化验证配对，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is necessary, not just for safety.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化验证是必需的，而不只是为安全。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain and sample-efficiency win, extending to all AI-generated code, not a niche.
carinahong.zh: 验证是性能增益与样本效率的胜利，应扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码，而非小众领域。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Safety must be done in public with iterative deployment and feedback, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 安全必须在公开环境中通过迭代部署和反馈来完成，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and human oversight.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的发展和人类监督。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based; AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽协作，而非轮次式；AI 应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能即压缩，而模型价值观并非内生，是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成；生成式 AI 应被视为乐器而非造假，产品界面必须容错，并与算法能力相匹配。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its big-company impact is overhyped, and inference's marginal cost will force new business models.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 类比智能手机式的宏观变革，认为大公司受冲击被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施；推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Expose data via APIs and MCP so non-developers use AI tools; Spotify is the music industry's R&D department.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他主张通过 API 与 MCP 开放公司数据，让非开发者也能用上 AI 工具；Spotify 则扮演音乐产业的研发部门，把利润再投入增长。

gustav.en: No single right org model; long-tenure trust enables synchronized swimming, and AI should give users control over algorithms, not more addiction.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为没有唯一正确的组织模型：长期共事带来的信任让“花样游泳”式协同成为可能；AI 应让用户掌控算法，而非让人更上瘾，坚持“时间花得值”而非参与度指标。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; VM sandbox enables safe autonomy.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好在本地电脑上；VM 沙箱提供安全与保障，使其能自主安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not model capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; interaction should be asynchronous.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；理想交互是异步的，发出任务后不必盯着它工作。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, judge by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；关键是投资能力与安全，只以最终影响来评判。

felixrieseberg.en: Building prototypes fast beats writing specs; execution is cheap, and juniors can compress learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: 快速构建候选原型胜过写规格文档；执行如今很便宜，初级工程师可通过模拟项目把多年经验压缩到数周。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will go beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的设备,可穿戴设备终将走向皮下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention, not just talent.
jonyive.zh: 乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏;好奇心需要刻意与决心,而非天赋。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; being together matters.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思考的价值,共处本身不可替代。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity needs joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动,而非利润;真正的简洁需要愉悦与人性,而非空洞的极简。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not ashes.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动前进,而非为破坏而破坏;传统是保存火种,而非崇拜灰烬。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling still works; reasoning models via chain of thought and RL give more gains per compute, though progress is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更多提升，同时承认能力呈“锯齿状”。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling; focus shifts to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练 Scaling 放缓源于经济压力而非技术极限，业界转向更小、更便宜的模型部署。

kaiser.en: Post-training via RL and synthetic data drives recent gains; multimodal lags text, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出后训练（强化学习与合成数据）是近期模型进步的主要来源，而多模态仍落后于文本，像小块补丁一样顺序处理输入。

kaiser.en: Reasoning alone isn't enough for generalization; models need vast data, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：仅靠推理不足以实现泛化，模型需耗尽表面模式后才学得概念，而人类能从少量样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes but needs oversight; near-term risks like hacking outweigh existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式实践：编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍，强化学习可跨域泛化但需可扩展监督，并认为系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI system design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统设计：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference is limited by the memory wall, not compute, explaining context window stagnation; sparse attention helps KV cache but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文推理受内存墙而非算力限制，这解释了上下文窗口的停滞；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, drives design.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为减少搬运而存在。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput ~3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：面积随位宽呈二次增长，使 FP4 吞吐量约为 FP8 的 3 倍。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审查促进安全，当前开源模型并不比网页搜索带来更多边际危险。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical; value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步强调：算力扩张不是唯一路径，算法效率提升和预训练数据质量同等关键；模型是应用的起点，价值将沉淀在应用层，垂直专用模型会由应用方而非模型提供方构建。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open source empowers enterprises; AI augments jobs, requiring human-in-the-loop and AI literacy.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他把开源立场延伸到主权 AI：AI 应去中心化，主权 AI 要求控制数据、基础设施和价值观；开源模型比集中式系统更能赋能企业；AI 会增强而非取代工作，需要人类在环和 AI 素养教育。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and enterprise customization; AGI as one system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向下游应用和定制；预训练正触及饱和墙，进展来自领域特定微调；作为单一系统解决所有问题的 AGI 永远不会存在，未来在垂直专业化而非横向通用提升。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施，否则将受制于美国科技巨头；企业 AI 采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能，智能体平台需人类在环验证；AGI 是混乱而具体的方向，不是终点。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute become new scaling axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，因此算法创新与推理时算力成为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead; they just require exponentially more compute for the same improvement, creating pressure for innovation. Post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是同样提升需要指数级更多算力，这倒逼创新。语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客行为。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，从视觉的纯迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and fine-tuning can undo alignment with minimal compute.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身；微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐，但这并不意外。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, with SFT giving 90% of gains.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量远胜算法选择，SFT 贡献九成性能，DPO 与强化学习补上关键的一成。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough but harder than RLHF; overoptimization is pervasive, and inference-time scaling plots are a 'scope'.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练最大突破，却比 RLHF 更难，过优化普遍存在，并直言推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线是一种“障眼法”。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese open models like Qwen and DeepSeek now dominate openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 必须完全透明，公开数据、中间检查点与配方而非仅权重；并指出 Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国开放模型已主导开放生态，美国开源出现真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling, and AGI arrives via messy co-evolution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理 Scaling（规模扩张）；AGI（通用人工智能）将经由混乱的协同演化到来，而非突然的奇点。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; designers should trust intuition and start from solutions, not problem statements.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；设计师应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题陈述出发。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and ship fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: AI 杀死了研究-发散-收敛流程；设计师减少画稿，帮助工程师执行，快速交付以建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、以及白纸般的‘ cracked new grads’。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks to 3-6 months; taste alone won't save designers—judgment, authority, and vision are key.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野缩短至 3-6 个月；仅靠品味救不了设计师——判断力、权威和视野才是关键。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; speed is not an improvement, and 'everyone is using it' is not a design argument.
jennywen.zh: 把工作和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；速度不是改进，‘大家都在用’不是设计论据。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; Scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏压缩到 10 亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; we are in the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；并强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL for LLMs is terrible, synthetic data lacks entropy, and model collapse is fundamental.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”；指出 LLM 的强化学习很糟糕、合成数据缺乏熵、模型崩溃是根本问题。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: I haven't typed code since December; you can outsource thinking but not understanding—that remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：自去年 12 月起不再手写代码；你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解——理解仍是人类瓶颈。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待它们：成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human analogies; give a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在处境，而不只是套用人类类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance.
askell.zh: 这份 constitution 更接近德性伦理，塑造的是整体性格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调：超越训练分布的泛化能力是机器学习缺失的核心，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots needs sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization via modular motor policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他指出：把好奇心扩展到真实机器人，需要样本效率、动态动作空间，以及通过模块化运动策略实现的跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data are the bottleneck, not raw algorithms or compute alone.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：泛化与数据才是瓶颈，而非单纯的算法或算力。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：机器人是数据问题——没有机器人数据的互联网，因此配方是视频与仿真上的预训练，加上真实数据的后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; deployment, not software-style scaling, is the real challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他提出：像语言领域的 ChatGPT 一样，通用大脑可驱动任何机器人；真正的挑战是部署，而非软件式的规模扩张。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make them interpretable today.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的模块化系统；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让它们可解释。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation; data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical.
kendall.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；通过课程学习和合成数据提升数据效率至关重要。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, like AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；完美的仿真器就等于解决了自动驾驶，类似 AlphaGo。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 语言整合改善表征、推理与个性化；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis, not expensive retrofits.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更重要；带内置传感器的大众市场车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模，而非昂贵的改装。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, and let real-world feedback reveal emergent properties.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样迭代，每日发布，让真实世界反馈揭示涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来；它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows——界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开；前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，由减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富含可供性的产品；推理模型必须无缝产品化。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks or leaderboards, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估、而非基准或排行榜，才是推动 AI 真正进步的关键；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法抵达，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function and values, so no single model will rule all; companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数与价值观不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切；每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: From data quality to medicine: human judgment and taste remain central as models hallucinate and reward hack.
edwinchen.zh: 从数据质量到医疗：随着模型产生幻觉与奖励黑客，人类判断与品味始终是核心。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety must outrank accuracy; the biggest risk may be omission, so AI should augment, not replace, judgment.
edwinchen.zh: 在医疗中，安全必须优先于准确；最大风险或许是遗漏，因此 AI 应增强而非取代判断。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，而对齐挑战也日益紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major OpenAI milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 的重要里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得没有意义。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习来实现；专攻持续学习的实验室方向有误。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链，才能保住它的可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and start with simpler products before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调生存是核心价值观，初创公司必须把握节奏，先从更简单的产品做起，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: AI is commoditizing; the smartphone remains the best device for applied AI, with generative UI and agentic software as the future.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 正在商品化，智能手机仍是应用 AI 的最佳设备，未来在于生成式 UI 和智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; the word AI should be banned in product discussions, focusing instead on solving user pain points elegantly.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他直言大多数 AI 是胡扯，产品讨论中应禁用“AI”一词，转而优雅地解决用户痛点。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in mature categories; tech should be fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计是成熟品类中的首要差异化因素，科技应变得有趣以激发人类创造力。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will evolve into intent-based, proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他预测智能手机将演变为基于意图、主动的智能体；只有脑机接口能取代它，而非眼镜。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI for science 应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能带来广泛影响；AlphaFold 3、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch、AlphaGeometry 都是这一思路的产物。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时可被用于创造性发现，这与他坚持用困难评估指标迫使系统泛化而非记忆一脉相承。

kohli.en: Material science is more experimental than biology; AI impact there will take 5-10 years.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他判断材料科学比生物学更依赖实验，AI 在其中的影响需要 5 到 10 年；从 2 万到 220 万种材料的跃迁改变了格局，但实用性仍未知。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化了对大语言模型的判断：它们是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；可验证领域如代码才是 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为基于强化学习的后训练如今是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键，AlphaGo 的搜索技术已被用于矩阵乘法等科学问题，AlphaTensor 更发现了人类 50 年未找到的算法。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他明确可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需；AI 能给出正确却不可解释的证明，这挑战了人类的理解方式。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs hint at AGI, and video learning can train agents without costly RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具；认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张从视频中学习，让智能体无需昂贵强化学习即可训练。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential to beneficial AI; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not only large models.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性是构建有益技术的必要条件，并认为根本性创新可以来自任何地方，大模型并非全部。

nando.en: The goal remains AI that augments scientists and workers, creating new symbols and knowledge, while learning-to-learn now appears in few-shot prompting.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：AI 应增强科学家与劳动者，创造新符号与新知识；他早年看好的“学会学习”如今已体现在大模型的少样本提示中。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; we lack solutions, so containment and oversight remain open problems.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，认为这是当今最大挑战，且尚无解决方案，遏制与监督仍是开放问题。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: it leapfrogged legacy gaps, and local-language models can transform education; belief, not ability, is the main barrier.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化立场：非洲并未落后，反而跨越了历史遗留差距，本地语言模型可变革教育；非洲研究者最大的障碍是相信自己能申请顶尖机构，而非能力。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training and RLHF are crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题。

yejin.en: Smaller models with better inference algorithms and high-quality data can rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 更小的模型配合更好的推理算法与高质量数据，可以在特定任务上比肩更大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; open research and cross-institution collaboration counter closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 强化学习需要精细工程；开放研究与跨机构协作才能对抗封闭的前沿模型实验室。

yejin.en: Small language models, diverse synthetic data, and pluralistic alignment can democratize powerful AI.
yejin.zh: 小语言模型、多样化的合成数据与多元对齐，可以让强大的 AI 走向民主化。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs hallucinate from lack of embodied experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，能为知识提供根基并减少幻觉；LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身经验，而非仅训练数据问题。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning; unsupervised learning should do most of the work.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习最适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划；无监督学习应承担大部分工作，强化学习只是锦上添花。

jimfan.en: Simulation and synthetic data are key for scaling embodied agents, providing infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调仿真与合成数据是扩展具身智能体的关键，在互联网高质量 token 耗尽时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics will come in about five years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出构建简单、端到端、能利用多样数据的机器人基础模型是关键；机器人学的 GPT-3 时刻约五年后到来，但家庭使用因安全和非结构化环境会更晚。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis; reliability over time horizon, not raw capability, defines agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调语言模型上的强化学习开辟了预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；衡量智能体的标准是随时间跨度的可靠性，而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Verifiable rewards in math and code drive expert performance; coding is the leading indicator of AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出数学与代码等可验证奖励是达到专家级表现的关键突破；编程是 AI 进展的领先指标，并将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; Transformers need no new architecture, but inference compute becomes the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），Transformer 无需全新架构，但推理算力将在 2028 年前后成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents, with compute as the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型存在巨大能力过剩，编排工具比原始智能更重要；未来工作是管理智能体团队，算力成为新石油，而世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; ship fast, use familiar patterns, and chase ROI over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应写代码以建立共情、加快交付；快速发布、沿用熟悉交互模式，追求投入产出比而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; get more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本，能力增强但不应让用户感觉更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation, not just visual guidelines.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续把品牌视为招聘与差异化的战略武器，而非静态视觉规范。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection; gut decisions often beat data in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调速度与决断胜过完美，在高速成长的初创公司里直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, give designers ownership; avoid rigid crits, adapt process to the problem.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他主张招聘多元类型人才、赋予设计师自主权；避免僵化评审，让流程适配问题而非套用模板。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should act as enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems while treating AI as a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师、对齐问题，并把 AI 当作创作伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality behaves like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需通过快速、粗糙的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth, leaving 90s layer-panel tools as legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的，以代码为真相来源，90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗留产物。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small designer-engineer teams beat large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才最有价值；小型设计师-工程师团队胜过大型跨职能小组。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议先积累技能，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved. Post-training alone can't align AGI; regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队解散；认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI，需要第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Empirical alignment testing and measuring progress now is crucial; uncertainty about alignment is the core risk.
leike.zh: 始终强调实证对齐测试和当下衡量进展至关重要；对齐状态的不确定性才是核心风险。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年时他仍相信缩放定律能带来可预测的进步，但已判断测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Custom models went from a surprise to essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, alongside frontier models.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从意外之举变成必需品：Cursor 的每个高光时刻如今都离不开自研模型，与前沿模型并用。

truell.en: Programming is shifting from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年他进一步深化：编程正从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎细致更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift will outstrip the internet and unfold over decades; the IDE market is far larger, and senior engineers underrate AI while juniors over-rely on it.
truell.zh: 2025 年他给出更宏观的判断：这场 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、要数十年才展开，IDE 市场远大于以往，资深工程师低估 AI 而初级工程师过度依赖。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction; Scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI; dialogue is the killer app.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，Noam Shazeer 强调 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据带来更智能的 AI，对话是杀手级应用。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is key; models need trillion-token context windows; modular sparse architectures like MoE enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他转向推理时算力扩展，认为需要万亿级上下文窗口，模块化稀疏架构如混合专家实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial; open-source keeps pace with frontier models.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化观点：测试时算力扩展推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要，开源模型正追赶前沿模型。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data is central; neural networks are opaque; AI safety needs engineering safeguards and human oversight.
shazeer.zh: 始终，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据是核心，神经网络不透明，AI 安全需要工程保障和人类监督。

shazeer.en: From passive next-token prediction to active world interaction and continual learning with modular components.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，他从被动的下一个词预测转向主动的世界交互和模块化持续学习。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, so simulation and self-play drive learning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，而当时的强化学习做不到；因此靠模拟与自博弈提供学习信号。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation and augmentation, not be hard-coded into networks; fine-tuning pre-trained models is a major win.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他一贯主张先验知识应用于数据生成与增强，而非硬编码进网络；并认为微调大型预训练模型是重大成功。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers beyond language.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出无监督学习结合强化学习能大幅提升样本效率；预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Real-world value demands 99.9% reliability; a single network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他强调创造真实价值需要 99.9%的可靠性，并展示单个神经网络可泛化到不同仓储任务与末端执行器。

abbeel.en: Human brain's generality inspires AI, but current AI is far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real environments.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 年，他认为人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不够通用；好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败。
